question: What is the status of the knowers' own powers in relation to the means of knowledge?
premises: The knowers' own powers fall within the domain of the means of knowledge.
Power is understood as fitness for activity.
This fitness for activity belongs to those powers.
inference: Therefore the powers of the knowers function as the means of knowledge because their essence is the capacity to act.
plain_english: Their own powers fall within the sphere of the means of knowledge. We understand power to be precisely this fitness for activity.
